For avoidance of doubt, payments will be made only after receiving exemption from tax deduction approval from the tax authority in Israel. Delay in payment as a result of not receiving such exemption will not constitute late payment or breach hereunder.
findings.explanation: Your payment is conditioned on receiving a tax exemption approval, which can result in indefinite payment delays without constituting a breach.
findings.suggested_change: Payments shall be made in accordance with the agreed payment schedule regardless of the timing of tax exemption approvals.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose one adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause about tax exemption approvals, the current wording conditions payment on receiving this approval, which could lead to indefinite delays. I propose modifying this so that payments shall be made in accordance with the agreed payment schedule regardless of the timing of tax exemption approvals. Thank you for your time and flexibility on this matter.
